steps.title: Seat the STM32 board on the breadboard
steps.check: The STM32 board sits flat in the breadboard, across the centre gap
steps.correction: Stop. Seat the STM32 board first.

steps.title: Seat the OLED display on the breadboard
steps.check: The OLED display sits in the breadboard beside the STM32 board
steps.correction: Stop. Seat the OLED display first.

steps.title: Connect the two power wires
steps.check: A red wire and a black wire run between the STM32 board and the display
steps.correction: Stop. Connect the power wires first.

steps.title: Connect the two signal wires
steps.check: Four wires in total run between the STM32 board and the display
steps.correction: Stop. Connect the signal wires first.

steps.title: Plug in the USB cable last
steps.check: The USB cable is plugged into the STM32 board
steps.correction: Stop. Plug in the USB cable last.
